quotes.text: This is a terrible app with equally terrible customer support. I've attempted to contact them through both messages and calls, but all interactions are automated with no genuine human connection or assistance. I'm going to uninstall this app immediately.

Fix the bugs, the nifty prices are shown different in different time frames and lots of lagging like 15-20 second I have to wait every time for loading the charts for last month after the recent update... so team Groww please fix these problems. thank you
overall good but too many charges 😔 1 buy + sell order (fno) cause me 92. brokerage 40 and external charges 50😅.

fee_issue.what_users_think: Users believe the app deducts various fees without clear disclosure or prior notice, making the service feel misleading and unfair.
fee_issue.what_confuses_them: They are unsure which actions trigger charges such as DDPI activation, haircut fees on leveraged stocks, brokerage, SIP bounce, or tax deductions, and the UI does not clearly indicate when or why these amounts are taken.
confusion_patterns: other charges seen as hidden (taxes, DP, exchange)
unexpected deduction or charge on failed or cancelled order
